court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Arvind Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Revenue

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Revenue Lko. And 6 Others

facts_of_case: Petitioner's claim is based on order dated 01.04.2017 passed by Civil Judge, (S.D.), Lucknow in Misc. Case No.93C/2012. Petitioner says he is entitled to get his name mutated in the property of late Nattha Ram as succession certificate was issued.

legal_principles.principle: A succession certificate is granted for limited purpose and a court granting succession certificate does not decide the question of title.
legal_principles.held: It would be apt to indicate that a succession certificate is granted for limited purpose and a court granting succession certificate does not decide the question of title.

legal_principles.principle: Mutation proceedings are summary in nature and they do not decide any right or title between the parties; rather they are drawn only for fiscal purposes.
legal_principles.held: Mutation proceedings are summary in nature and they do not decide any right or title between the parties; rather they are drawn only for fiscal purposes.

legal_principles.principle: The order passed in mutation proceedings are always subject to declaration of rights which may be sought by the parties concerned by instituting a regular suit.
legal_principles.held: The order passed in mutation proceedings are always subject to declaration of rights which may be sought by the parties concerned by instituting a regular suit.

legal_principles.principle: Mutation of a property in revenue record does not create or extinguish title nor has it any presumptive value on title.
legal_principles.held: Mutation of a property in revenue record does not create or extinguish title nor has it any presumptive value on title.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's claim is basically based upon the order dated 01.04.2017 passed by the Civil Judge, (S.D.), Lucknow in Misc. Case No.93C/2012.

keywords: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
